messages.author: 9b9b249f698e0871
messages.subject: Consistent pattern in residuals.
parts:
Just wondering if anyone could give me a hand, 

This is the model I am currently working on, 

basic.kob.model.sqrt <- inla(sqrt_dens ~ as.factor(time) + scaled.dist
                             + scaled.NPP + scaled.ANC
                        +  f(ID, model = "besag", graph = "nblist.txt", 
                             scale.model=TRUE,
                             hyper = list(prec = list(prior = "pc.prec",
                                                      param = c(.1,0.5)))),
                        family = "gaussian", control.compute =
                          list(dic=TRUE, waic = TRUE),
                        control.family = list( 
                          hyper = list(prec = list(initial = 1/var(kob.long$sqrt_dens, na.rm = T), fixed=T))), 
                        data = kob.long@data)

The data are animal densities per km^2, square root transformed. I am consistently getting a positive correlation between the residuals and the predicted values (stronger with some transformations than with others) - please see image. 

Can anyone shed any light on why this might be happening, or suggest a more suitable model? 

Please let me know if you need any other info.
Duncan

messages.author: 9b9b249f698e0871
messages.subject: Re: Consistent pattern in residuals.
parts:
Somebody very helpfully replied via email, that I should be using a Poisson distribution for family with the original count data, using the E argument to specify the area. 

Unfortunately I don't have most of the original count data, just the calculated densities.  

Hope that helps a little. 

Duncan
